intention: charging derives two fields on write. It promotes an entry to StatusDone when the submitted status is StatusInProgress and every DONE-required field is present, reusing missingFields against RequiredFieldsFor(StatusDone) and never demoting (RD1), on both Create and Update (RD2). It adds a price_source column (USER / UNCONFIRMED) that records whether a zero price is a real free charge or forgotten data, computed by the module from a caller-supplied PriceConfirmed boolean (RD3, RD4). No index (RD5).

decisions.decision: The Down migration is a plain DROP COLUMN, unguarded. Rolling back loses which zero prices were confirmed real. A guard that refuses when any price_source='USER' AND price=0 row exists was offered and declined.
decisions.why: Nothing here is impossible to roll back, only lossy, and 20260720000001's Down already accepts the same shape of loss for its own backfill.
